works.subject: Lancemore Lindenderry Red Hill - accommodation
works.embeddedDescription: If ever there was a place for you to rest and dream, it is Lancemore Lindenderry Red Hill. Set in the very heart of Red Hill amongst 34 stunning acres of gardens and vines, our luxury Mornington Peninsula accommodation is ideally positioned to soak up the spectacular views of pure-sand beaches, soul-enriching nature, artisan produce and mere minutes from the region’s most revered cool climate wineries.
works.credit: Photo courtesy of Visit Victoria
